text: Accepted nsImapProtocol still says DiscoveryDone will close the databases left open by unsubscribed LIST. The later selected-path commit removes CloseFoldersDB, and the inspected current DiscoveryDone contains no such bulk helper call. Other current URL and folder paths release individual databases, so this is a stale explanation of the named ownership path, not proof of a leak. When updating this area, rewrite the comment to name the actual current lifecycle and retain the database-cache regression assertions. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
